text: Together with Libera and Virgo, follow Sherry and Cersier\nto the place you have never visited in the day region of\nthe sakura world!
Crystal monsters are invading the area around Sakura Castle.\nGet in the castle and head for the top of the donjon to\ncheck the safety of Celesa, the lord of the castle!
Fight Mimesia, the crystal monster that looks like Celesa.\nIf it's really Celesa, restore her to her original self!
